purpose: Exact privileged Edge Function set intentionally deferred until executable source caller semantics are preserved or final cutover makes the independent target authoritative.

policy.caller_evidence_rule: Count only executable call paths such as cron.schedule/net.http_post, direct fetch, Supabase functions.invoke, or a dynamic dispatcher whose resolved target is proven. UI labels, health rows, registries, comments, scripts and string mentions are not callers by themselves.
policy.historical_vs_live_rule: A committed executable migration proves a historical caller definition, not that the corresponding job or trigger is currently active in the live Lovable source. Live activation remains unresolved until source database/runtime inventory is obtained.
policy.pre_cutover: Do not weaken authorization and do not add a new handler guard on main when an unobservable Lovable/platform caller could be broken.
policy.cutover: Every entry must receive an explicit caller trust boundary before Lovable-pause readiness can pass.
policy.forbidden_shortcut: A Supabase anon/publishable key or gateway verify_jwt alone is not privileged authorization.
